description: The full text of one maps-agent.com page as markdown: title, canonical URL, last-updated date, the answer-first opening, the body with tables, FAQs and numbered sources. Works for any public page on the site, by the id search returns, a URL, a path or a slug. The markdown is in the text block and in body_markdown; pass part to continue a long page.

detail.description: structured (default): the markdown is in the text block and in structuredContent.body_markdown. text: only in the text block.

form.description: Which form a bare slug belongs to, when the same slug exists in more than one.

id.description: A maps-agent.com page URL (https://maps-agent.com/answers/how-to-get-more-google-reviews), a site path (/glossary/citation) or a slug or id from search / list_articles.

part.description: Which part to read, starting at 1. The first part gives the contents of a longer page.

name: fetch

body_markdown.description: Markdown for this part of the page, the same as the text block. Omitted when detail is text.

contents.description: Headings from a longer article, returned in the first part.

facts.description: Source confidence and reading date for registry facts cited by the page.

faqs.description: The page's FAQ, also at the end of body_markdown.

id.description: The page's id for fetch: its full URL.

sources.description: The sources the page cites; `key` is the footnote marker [^key] in body_markdown.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences: the page's description or opening.

terms.description: The terms this answer is given under: quote with a link to the page; a copy of the base needs an agreement.

topic.description: Grouping inside the form: answer cluster, guide kind, trade, blog vertical.

total_parts.description: Use part to read further when the page spans multiple parts.

updated.description: The page's own last-updated day, YYYY-MM-DD.

url.description: The page on maps-agent.com — cite it.

title: Read a page in full
